company.name: AeroFreight Inc.
company.summary: Fictional Delaware C-corp Series B with the unusual but documented double-participating-cap structure: BOTH Series A and Series B carry participating-with-cap LPs at different cap multiples (Series A 2x, Series B 3x). The cap-reach sequence runs through two regime transitions, then both seniors pure-convert at the high end. This exercises the engine's senior-above-capped pathway and the regime-state algorithm under stacked caps. All clauses trace to NVCA Model Charter §2.2 (Participation) and §2.3 (Conversion), with the participating-with-cap mechanics directly mirroring Eqvista's worked-example treatment.

anti_dilution.notes: NVCA Model Charter §4.4(c) BBWA. No down-round trigger to date — Series B priced up at $4.00.
NVCA Model Charter §4.4(c) BBWA, no trigger.

side_letters.title: Series B lead-investor MFN clause
side_letters.summary: Series B lead has a most-favored-nation right tied to LP cap re-negotiation in any future Series C round. No present-day cap-table impact; flagged to the analyst for awareness if this is a snapshot prior to a contemplated Series C.
side_letters.body: If, in any subsequent priced round, the Company grants any holder of preferred stock a participation cap less restrictive than the Series B 3x cap, the Series B holders shall automatically receive the benefit of such less-restrictive cap on a no-action basis. Source: AeroFreight Series B Stockholders' Agreement §4.7 (MFN — economic terms).
